home.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
home.faq.1.question: What types of casino games do you develop?
home.faq.1.answer: We develop a wide range of casino products including slot, instant, and table games, plus custom mechanics tailored to operator needs. Each game is designed to maximize engagement, retention, and revenue performance.
home.faq.2.question: How long does it take to develop a casino game?
home.faq.2.answer: Development timelines depend on complexity. Standard slot projects typically take 3–6 months, while advanced mechanics or custom game concepts may require 6–12 months.
home.faq.3.question: Can I order a fully customized casino game?
home.faq.3.answer: Yes. We design fully customized games aligned with your brand, audience, and platform requirements, from theme and visuals to mechanics and reward systems.
home.faq.4.question: How do you ensure game quality and fairness?
home.faq.4.answer: Every game undergoes extensive testing including functional QA, performance testing, and RNG validation to ensure fair gameplay and stable performance.
home.faq.5.question: Do you provide post-launch support?
home.faq.5.answer: Yes. We provide ongoing support, updates, and performance optimization to ensure games remain competitive and profitable over time.
